name: Dialog
description: A modal window that asks for a decision or a short input, over a dimmed page.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown. Controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog asks to close: Escape, the close button, or a backdrop click.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the bottom; put the primary action last.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content between the description and the actions.

a11y: Uses the native <dialog> element with showModal(), so focus is trapped and the page is inert.
aria-labelledby and aria-describedby point at the title and description.
Escape and the close button close it; focus returns to the element that opened it.
The close button has an accessible name.
